scientific_integrity: Proved via integral blow-up and Enriques topology; checker validates lattice arithmetic, not the geometric premises. The explicit arXiv v1 degree-five vanishing entry is contradicted.
scientific_limitations: Applies to general smooth complex Enriques centers in the named Fano construction; no full Chow multiplication; the journal version full text was not compared, so priority and later correction status remain uncertain.
title: Integral middle topology and codimension-two cycles of Enriques Fano hosts
